title: Staff of Cherished Necromancy

sources.title: Heightened Necromancy
markers: | description = Creatures have {{Disadvantage}} on {{SavingThrow}}s against your [[Necromancy|necromancy spells]].

sources.title: Life Essence Harvest
markers: | description = When the wielder kills a hostile creature with a spell, they greedily absorb its energy and gain {{Cond|Life Essence}} until their next Long Rest.

summary: Empowers Necromancy and harvests free spell casts from hostile kills.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, Versatile, 5 ft melee, Dippable. 1d6 + 2 one-handed or 1d8 + 2 two-handed Bludgeoning plus Strength. +2 to attack rolls. Adds 1d4 Necrotic on a hit.
fields.Heightened Necromancy: Targets have Disadvantage on saves against your Necromancy spells.
fields.Life Essence Harvest: Direct spell kill of a hostile creature grants Life Essence until Long Rest. Toggle on to cast Necromancy without a slot. Indirect kills and spells cast free via Life Essence do not create more essence. The source reports any spell level can currently use it.
fields.Topple: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn. Prone breaks Concentration and expires at the start of the target’s turn. Topple skips main-hand weapon effects.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
